title: Self-Regulation for Reputation-Sensitive Buyers: SA8000 in China
authors: Greg Distelhorst; Judith C. Stroehle; Duanyi Yang
eligible_reason: Table 4 top panel reports static TWFE panel regressions of seven outcomes on certified_any (binary SA8000 certification indicator switching on at factory-specific years, 11 first-certification cohorts 1998-2008 among 206 ever-certified factories) with factory and year FE, no controls, clustered by factory, on the full 1998-2008 panel of Chinese industrial firms with a very large never-certified control group.
design_notes: Factory-year panel of large Chinese industrial firms 1998-2008 (SA8000_main_sample.dta, 1,448,418 firm-years, 386k panelids). cert_startyr distribution among ever-certified factories (log line 288): 1998:1, 1999:5, 2000:2, 2001:4, 2002:7, 2003:10, 2004:26, 2005:39, 2006:36, 2007:43, 2008:33 (total 206); certified_any==1 in 555 firm-years. Panel FE models (Table 4 top; A9; A10) use xtreg fe with year dummies. Bottom panel of Table 4 is a 2004-vs-2008 DiD on entropy-balanced samples (ebalance, weights constant within panelid); Table A8 uses CEM weights from R (MatchIt). Selection do-file regresses pre-period characteristics on ever-treated status. Figures in R. No Goodman-Bacon decomposition or modern estimator code in the package despite the full-text citation.
estimators_reported: TWFE static panel FE (xtreg fe + year dummies)

specs.treatment_definition: certified_any = 1 if certifiedpct > 0 (factory SA8000-certified for any part of the year), 0 otherwise (missing certification data treated as uncertified); cert_startyr = first certification year varies 1998-2008
specs.sample_condition: full main sample SA8000_main_sample.dta (all large Chinese industrial firms 1998-2008; about 1.45M firm-years, 386k firms)
specs.notes: xtreg `dv' certified_any i.year, fe cluster(panelid); outreg2 to output/panel_FE.xls. certified_any may switch off if certification lapses (certifiedpct==0 after certification); apply Hull footnote 6 (drop post-adoption periods with treatment off). Appendix Table A9 repeats excluding 3 EICC firms (line 246); Table A10 adds sales_perworker_ln control (ineligible).

specs.exclusion_reason: two-period design (year 2004 vs 2008 only) with entropy-balancing weights (ebalance) and a single treatment date (cert_2008 = certified 2005-2007 observed in 2008); also CEM-weighted version (Table A8) and productivity-control version (A10)
specs.reported_location: Table 4 bottom panel; Tables A8, A10

specs.exclusion_reason: selection analysis: cross-sectional regressions of pre-certification characteristics on ever-treated indicator (reghdfe `dv' treated ...)

screener_notes: Screened from package only. Whether certified_any ever switches off cannot be verified without opening the data; certifiedpct is a within-year certification share so lapses are possible. Published coefficients taken from output/panel_FE.txt (14 columns = the 7 outcomes repeated; identical values).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: cert_startyr 1998-2008; the 1998 cohort (1 factory) has no pre-period and the 2008 cohort (33) has one post year.
data_files_note: Shipped data are the authors' processed extracts of official Chinese industrial survey microdata; README describes them as the main sample without any disguise statement.
software_notes: Stata/MP 14.2 (xtreg, reghdfe, ebalance, outreg2) + R 4.3.1 (MatchIt for CEM, figures)
